summary: The TARA Brain Atlas replaces hand-drawn brain pictures with cited, licence-cleared atlas geometry tied to QIF regions, pathways, devices and techniques, shown in the explorer at /atlas/anatomy/ and as a region view mounted on other pages. Every mapping is AI-drafted and unreviewed until the owner records a review, and the site states that and its other limits wherever the data appears.

changes.summary: Change a band colour or the selection colour
changes.note: Bands are two ordinal ramps split on the forebrain boundary, not seven categories: one hue carries at most five steps before adjacent steps fall under the lightness-gap floor. Validate any new step with the dataviz validator (per family, --ordinal) before editing, and keep the selection colour neutral so it cannot read as a band.
